# Anoop Sinkaran
**Senior Test Automation Engineer | SDET | QA Lead**  
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

---

### Professional Summary
Seasoned Senior Quality and Test Automation Engineer with over 19 years of experience designing and executing end-to-end automation frameworks using Playwright, TypeScript, C#, and Selenium across distributed cloud platforms and enterprise applications. Proven expertise in building automated API regression suites, authoring detailed test strategies and manual test cases, and establishing continuous testing practices within modern CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and Azure DevOps. Strong communicator and cross-functional QA leader with a track record of driving defect triage, troubleshooting complex issues, and aligning engineering deliverables with business requirements.

### Professional Experience

#### **Wpay (Woolworths Group)** | Sydney, Australia
**Senior Quality Engineer** | November 2021 – Present

- **Situation:** Wpay required robust automated verification and high quality standards across its distributed digital payment, gift card, and Android terminal ecosystems.
- **Task:** Build end-to-end automation suites, automate API validation, formulate comprehensive test scenarios, and optimize CI/CD pipeline verification.
- **Action:**
  - Developed and maintained a full end-to-end automation suite using **Playwright** and **TypeScript** covering critical gift card activation and redemption user flows.
  - Engineered **Azure DevOps** CI/CD pipelines to execute automated **API Gateway** regression suites and embedded Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for continuous vulnerability analysis.
  - Formulated comprehensive test strategies, manual test cases, documentation, and pilot programs to validate card payment message structures, failure modes, and edge cases prior to rollout.
  - Functioned in a dual Business Analyst / QA capacity to define detailed user stories and technical design specifications for a terminal licensing and onboarding gateway.
  - Implemented custom **GitHub** Copilot SKILLs and automated PR review workflows, identifying coverage gaps and breaking changes automatically to streamline peer review cycles.
  - Automated functional testing for native iOS and Android payment applications leveraging Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, and Robolectric for unit and UI testing.
- **Result:** Successfully elevated test coverage across core payment components, eliminated regression bottlenecks in CI/CD, and safeguarded system reliability ahead of mass market deployments.

**Senior Quality Engineer** | June 2021 – September 2021

- **Result:** Improved functional stability of enterprise web releases and standardized test practices across sprint teams.

**QA Lead / Senior Automation Test Analyst** | April 2019 – April 2021

  - Directed cross-functional release cycles and alignment sessions, facilitating daily defect triage meetings with development and product leads.
  - Troubleshot critical platform defects, analyzed logs and functional gaps, and communicated issue reproduction paths clearly to engineering stakeholders.
- **Result:** Delivered the platform migration on schedule with intact data fidelity, zero critical defect escapes, and strict enforcement of quality gates.
